title: PaymentRejected v1 - data
description: The platform refused to start a payment before the gateway was called (e.g. PREMIUM_MISMATCH, PROPOSAL_NOT_PAYABLE). Distinct from PaymentDeclined (gateway decision). Producer: payment. Status: CONTRACTED. The `data` member of event-envelope/v1 (ADR-025): ids and states only, never customer PII.
